description: This file defines the NotificationScheduler class responsible for scheduling periodic background work related to event reminders and widget updates in an Android application, utilizing WorkManager.

classes.name: NotificationScheduler
classes.description: A class for scheduling notifications and widget updates periodically using Android's WorkManager.

methods.name: scheduleNotifications
methods.description: Public method to schedule event reminders and widget updates.

methods.name: scheduleEventReminders
methods.description: Private method to set up and enqueue a periodic work request for event reminders every day.

methods.name: scheduleWidgetUpdates
methods.description: Private method to set up and enqueue a periodic work request for widget updates every 15 minutes.
